description: Variation of condition 2 of 25/02585/FUL to increase occupancy to nine residents.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan AR01 July 2025Block Plan AR02 July 2025Existing Ground Floor Plan Existing First Floor Plan AR03 July 2025Proposed Ground Floor Plan Proposed First Floor Plan AR04 July 2025Existing Second Floor Plan Existing Roof Plan AR05 July 2025Proposed Second Floor Plan Proposed Roof Plan AR06 July 2025Existing Section A-A AR07 July 2025Proposed Section A-A AR08 July 2025Existing Front & Rear Elevations AR09 July 2025Proposed Front & Rear Elevations AR10 July 2025Existing Side Elevations AR11 July 2025Proposed Side Elevations AR12 July 2025Cover Letter dated 12.02.2026Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than nine residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect the adjoining premises/immediate.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the communal kitchen and dining/living rooms shall be retained in perpetuity. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Notwithstanding the cycle parking indicated on drawing 'Block Plan AR02 dated July 2025', and within six months of the date of this permission, cycle parking shall be provided in compliance with the following criteria:o Provision of a minimum of NINE long stay cycle parking spaces.o in an accessible location: the access route to the long stay store should be a minimum of 1.2m wide to enable the bike to enter the store, should be step free and involve no more than 2 doors or gates (excluding the store door) which must also have a minimum opening width of 1.2m;o secured: with a British Standard mortice lock or access fob;o fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roof.Reason: To ensure the provision and availability of adequate cycle parking.

The facilities for the storage of recycling containers, wheeled refuse bins, and any other refuse storage containers including their materials and design specifications shall be implemented in accordance with the details approved within application ref. 26/00652/CND.Reason: To ensure that sufficient provision at all times for the storage and collection of waste and to preserve the character and appearance of the conservation area.

Notwithstanding condition 1 (approved plans), within six months of the date of this decision, the following facilities for the storage and preparation of food shall be installed within the development to meet the needs of future occupiers, in accordance with Enfield's HMO Standards for bedsit/letting rooms and shared accommodation (2021). These facilities shall be retained permanently thereafter:o	Two full-sized cookers, each comprising a minimum of four ring hobs, a standard oven, and a grill;o	Two kitchen sinks, each with minimum dimensions of 600 mm x 1000 mm;o	Two refrigerators and two freezers;o	One double wall cupboard or one single base unit (excluding the space beneath the sink units) for the storage of dry goods and utensils.Reason: To ensure adequate food storage and preparation facilities are provided for the health and well-being of future occupiers.
